requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with an increased bottle size for CMY (>8,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: To improve customer value by increasing ink yield and reducing replacement frequency, aligning with market expectations for high-yield consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, SuperAmp PHA, and new IDS startup algorithm.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles must deliver 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle capacity greater than 8,000 pages, validated by page yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottles and associated filling mechanism provide spill-free reliability during the refill process.
requirements.Rationale: Minimize mess and user frustration during ink refilling, enhancing overall user experience and reducing support calls.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with NOA-F and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during 100 consecutive refill cycles in lab testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, maintaining compatibility with existing click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and reliability of the ink delivery system, preventing tampering and ensuring correct installation.
requirements.Dependencies: Must not alter push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes all tamper-resistance and installation validation tests without altering push-push and TDF functionality.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost by leveraging proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and IDS systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks operate within specification in the new system.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modelling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS performance, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product reliability and optimal performance throughout lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized IDS, bottle, and NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reliability models and data meet defined internal thresholds for each parameter (WVTR, air gain, flow rate, startup, EOL).

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Develop models for ink stability within the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To maintain consistent print quality over time and prevent ink degradation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized ink and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model validated by at least 12-month simulated aging tests with no PQ degradation.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F components as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient replacement and maintenance during warranty period, improving serviceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as service part and can be replaced within 30 minutes by authorized service personnel.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumably a security or authentication feature) on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product authentication and prevent counterfeiting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids pass Acumen 6 authentication in pilot production.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F, and add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Ensure manufacturing lines are capable of producing new components efficiently.
requirements.Dependencies: Finalized NOA-F and Magi ink cart design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines pass production readiness review for new components.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the system so that customers can replace the PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F themselves.
requirements.Rationale: Improves customer satisfaction and reduces service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires user-friendly design for PHA and NOA-F.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F using supplied instructions within 15 minutes.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes 80,000-page endurance test with no critical failures.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Print as a Service) and SMB Solutions
requirements.Description: Enable PaaS business models and SMB manageability, including onboarding paths for Consumer, HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new business models and expands market reach.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports all listed onboarding paths and PaaS functionality in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes for a 4-tube platform with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink delivery efficiency and supports increased tank size.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4-tube system passes flow and reliability tests in prototype builds.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for aerosol management due to tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink mist contamination and ensures workplace safety.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safety thresholds during extended operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamics and force models to accommodate new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and acceleration specs in test environments.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life goal (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures printer durability and consistent performance over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes 80,000-page reliability test.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part at service centers after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: Enables extended product life and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced by service center in under 1 hour.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection for IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and security of ink delivery system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connections pass 10,000-cycle durability and security tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to support new tank and bottle design.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printer startup and consistent ink flow.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer starts up successfully 99.9% of the time under standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality goals and ink depletion metrics to meet the defined page yield.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns product performance with marketing claims and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion meet or exceed targets in 95% of test units.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components operate within specification in the new system.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides modern connectivity and firmware capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware pass all connectivity and stability tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against unauthorized access and ensures data security.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All security tests and audits pass with no critical vulnerabilities.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and market requirements for environmental sustainability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all relevant certification audits.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to align with new tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and efficient use of space.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit with tank and pass all paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphics Display) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is fully functional and passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes all drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Scan Solution and Enterprise Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and enterprise manageability features (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses enterprise requirements and expands marketability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and manageability features are functional and pass enterprise pilot testing.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All clients and drivers are available and pass compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for productivity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput verified by standardized print speed tests.
